# SunCalc 2.1.1

Unmodified, readable upstream ES module from the pinned `v2.1.1` tag:
[source](https://github.com/mourner/suncalc/tree/v2.1.1).

`index.js` has no runtime dependencies. `LICENSE` contains the upstream BSD-2-Clause license. Localserve imports this bundled copy for offline solar times; it does not query an external service or transmit rule coordinates.
